The D CORE OT-XS1000G XPON SFP ONU Stick is a compact, high-performance Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) access solution designed for ISPs, enterprise networks, and advanced networking applications. Supporting both GPON and EPON (XPON) technologies, this SFP-form-factor ONU enables seamless integration directly into compatible switches, routers, and network devices equipped with SFP ports, eliminating the need for a separate ONU device.


Designed for stable Gigabit fiber connectivity, the OT-XS1000G delivers reliable data transmission, low latency, and excellent compatibility with a wide range of mainstream OLT brands. Its plug-and-play design simplifies FTTH deployments while reducing equipment footprint and power consumption. The module is ideal for Internet Service Providers (ISPs), enterprise fiber networks, smart buildings, campus environments, and data communication applications.


Whether you are deploying a new fiber network or upgrading an existing FTTH infrastructure, the D CORE OT-XS1000G XPON SFP ONU Stick offers a cost-effective, efficient, and reliable networking solution.


Key Features


  • XPON technology with GPON & EPON auto-detection
  • Standard SFP form factor for compact deployment
  • Direct installation into SFP-enabled switches and routers
  • Gigabit fiber access for high-speed broadband connectivity
  • Plug-and-play installation
  • Low power consumption and fanless operation
  • Stable and reliable FTTH performance
  • Compatible with major GPON and EPON OLT platforms
  • Ideal for ISP, enterprise, campus, and FTTH applications
  • Compact industrial-grade design
